protocol.component_controls: On the exact primary chart, reconstruct pinned-source corrected pre-attachment h22 from previously captured source raw h22, source state/frequency and source NQC coefficients. Also report frozen source/native raw same-state and own-state metrics, with no refit. Report corrected residual in entire common cap support, pre-native-match-minus-50M, native NQC-local 50M and post-native-boundary windows. Source attachment time is not captured, so these windows are descriptive and do not independently identify source NQC/attachment.
protocol.old_map_control: The obsolete low-endpoint+cropped-epoch formula assigned source index i the time exact t_i minus delta=0.0531240803315427 M. Hold native samples fixed and query the source corrected Re/Im natural-cubic interpolant at native t+delta. Report exact-versus-old-map phase/amplitude/complex metrics; this is a deliberately wrong chart, not a physical correction or a refit. The frozen 1169-sample sampled-peak anchor was derived from modes independently and did not use that obsolete formula.
protocol.primary: Replay the refined wholly native cap-start, source-backed flux/Hamiltonian, continuous NQC and boundary-frequency candidate used in full-crop v5. Its uncut h22 must exactly replay v5 full-series SHA/time/count. Compare physical h22 to stored pinned-source uncut corrected h22 on identical cap-time samples t=i*0.5 M, especially the predeclared 869 samples t=416.5..850.5 M. Initial orbital phase is zero in both cap states; apply only the established physical amplitude scale. No time shift, phase anchor, interpolation, or pairwise fit in this primary comparison.
protocol.resource_bound: One serial local refined native full-mode replay, reading frozen source/raw arrays and no source compile; expected 1-2 minutes, upper bound 4 minutes and under 4 GiB. Stop by SIGINT to the recorded PID. No production/pinned-source/README edits.
protocol.validity: Gate all direct and nested source/input SHA values; source-only v2, cap-raw and native full-v5 status; exact source cap mode hash/suffix; native cap initial state, full series hash/time/count, match/boundary times and exact 0.5 M chart; finite mode/factor/shifted controls; expected window counts. Preserve any failed-validity or runner-error artifact. Source raw*NQC reconstruction error and Torch/JAX legacy parity flags are findings, not qualification gates.
